message: 商店街のアイドル？

name: Nanaka
message: 「What a huge haul!」
Getting a ton of recycled goods from "Ponpoko" for the Charity Bazaar was great and all, but......

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn! Put some more spirit into pushing that handcart! Everyone else is out there busting their butts right now too!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Especially Misa! Didn't she say something like, 'Let's see who can collect more!'?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, what's wrong, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, sorry. I was just thinking about something.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tonight's dinner?」

name: Synn
message: 「No! I was just wondering if this is really okay......」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mhm. I don't know what it's about, but I allow it.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You've got zero grounds or authority for that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't care!」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, I'm grateful they donated so much, right? If they're this generous, how does 'Ponpoko' even make a profit?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Isn't it because secondhand goods like these don't cost anything to stock? Even a whole handcart full like this probably cost them zero to acquire.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, moving nothing but freebies like this won't make them any money, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Doesn't it draw in a crowd? If more people show up, more of them will end up buying the stuff with actual price tags too.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see! Tame-san sure knows how to do business.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Exactly, exactly. So don't worry about it. Let's ride on Tame-san's savvy coattails and keep gathering stuff at full speed!」

name: Paqy
message: 「If we're riding any coattails, I'd rather it be Synn-sama's wallet making a profit.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Yo. You two.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, hello.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hello!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Still no progress today, huh--just plain old good friends as usual.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, we are childhood friends.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's with that subtly suggestive phrasing?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Oh no, no, I'm merely stating the facts.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right, Nanaka. Being close is a good thing, isn't it? 'To be on good terms is a beautiful thing'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well... it's better than being on bad terms, I guess. Better than bad terms.」

name: Synn
message: 「You sound kinda negative about it... Wait, were we actually on bad terms?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, I didn't mean it like that...\s10」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「You two really do get along so well. What a dilemma. Even though youth is a brief, dazzling flash of heart-throbbing brilliance that passes by in an instant.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Still, if you don't make some progress soon, everyone in the shopping district is going to fret themselves sick.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't go turning us into gossip fodder without asking!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now, Nanaka. Spreading talk around is basically Auntie's job.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Indeed. After all, I am an apostle of truth.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're a greengrocer.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, what's been the topic of gossip this whole time?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「It's a heartwarming tale of the shopping district watching fondly over two young lovebirds. At this rate, maybe I ought to roll up my sleeves and revolutionize this situation!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Please don't.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「When someone offers goodwill, you're supposed to accept it.」

name: Synn
message: 「She's got a point, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're way too clueless, Synn... Oh, right.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Auntie. Besides 'Ponpoko' and 'Raffine,' do you know any other places that might donate secondhand goods to help out with the Charity Bazaar?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Nanaka-chan. A true Edoite knows when to push, and when to push him down in one go.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like I'd ever push him down!」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like I've been subtly left out of the loop this whole time.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't need to know!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Synn-sama is a lady-killer technician who just pretends to be dense.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Everyone already knows that. That's way too old news.」

name: Synn
message: 「Just what kind of things have you been saying about me?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「I'm an apostle of truth. Only the truth matters.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. That sounds kinda deep!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, more importantly, aren't there any shops that'll seriously help out with Chariba? You know a ton of people, Auntie.」

name: Synn
message: 「Tea-riba?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's short for Charity Bazaar. Man, girls these days shorten everything, it's a real pain.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Let's see... Places that deal in secondhand goods might be willing to help out, don't you think?」

name: Synn
message: 「Like the secondhand bookstore, 'Modern Antiquities'? He's pretty cranky, though, isn't he?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「If Nanaka-chan asks, things'll work out somehow. Following her lead, plenty of other places would probably listen too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm. I wonder about that. It's not like it'll bring them any business.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Nanaka is the shopping district's idol, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-Idol!? Come on, Synn, flattering me isn't gonna get you anything.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ow, ow.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「The only one who doesn't know is the girl herself.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Still, until last year, the Student Council President never came down to the shopping district to recruit in person. What brought on this sudden change? Is management struggling?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, charity and school management have nothing to do with each other.」

name: Synn
message: 「We want more people who don't normally visit the academy to participate. It'll be way livelier and more fun that way, don't you think?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Ho-ho. Lively and fun, eh... That's a wonderful thing.」

name: Synn
message: 「You sound kinda envious. Is business slow?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「No, it's not that. At least in Ryuusei Town, the economy isn't bad at all.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「It's just that the neighborhood association around here is getting older, and there are fewer kids now too.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Fewer people are carrying the shrine's portable shrine these days, you know... The festival's gotten smaller too. It's lonely, isn't it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, really?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. You probably didn't know since you're buried in part-time jobs rain or shine, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「I know! Why doesn't Shinagawa Greengrocer join the Charity Bazaar too? If possible, not just your place, ma'am, but all the shops in the shopping district!」

name: Synn
message: 「It might not replace the festival, but if you build ties with the academy, maybe more students will join the festival too.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「I see...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, that's a great idea.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「We're a greengrocer, though, you know. We don't exactly have secondhand goods to put out.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, right.」

name: Synn
message: 「Mgh... Guess things don't go that smoothly, huh.」
Hmm. I wonder if there's some good way to pull it off.

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Well, all that aside, to cheer up folks like us in a spiritual recession, I want to see some progress between you two! Speaking as a longtime viewer!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Am I a TV drama series to you?!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「You two are way too settled, like an old married couple sipping tea on the veranda.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jumping straight to an old married couple is way too far!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Everyone around here wants to hear how a tenderhearted girl decided to follow Synn-chan to the ends of the earth just because he said he'd become Student Council President!」

name: Nanaka & Synn
message: 「That's not why at all!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Hmph-hmph.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka's my childhood friend, so she just can't leave me to fend for myself.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah, that's all it is, that's all!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Speaking in unison--truly worthy of first place in the Ryuusei Shopping District Best Couple poll.」

name: Synn
message: 「What the heck is that.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Exactly what it sounds like, I bet.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「The results from a secret ballot last year. Oops, that was supposed to be a secret from the two of you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't just pick us without asking!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's the big deal? You're 'Best Couple.' If it were 'Worst,' you wouldn't even be able to look people in the eye.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It IS a big deal! Don't go deciding things on your own!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Investigating the latest public opinion is also the mission of an apostle of truth, you know~」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't 'Best Couple' a good thing? It just means we get along well.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Synn-chan, you haven't changed a bit. That's what's great about you. I want you to hold on to that pure, innocent sensibility forever and ever.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really get it, but I'll do my best to hold on to it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She's not complimenting you, Synn. Doesn't that just mean you're childish...」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Oh, right, right. Nanaka-chan.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I already told you, there's been no progress between us!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Putting stale gossip like that aside,」

name: Paqy
message: 「That got old fast.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「has your place been hit yet?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hit by what?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Dine-and-dashing, dine-and-dashing! Lately there's been a dine-and-dasher popping up around here. Judging by your reaction, Yuugiri-an is still safe, huh~」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How terrifying! We have to be careful too!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's nothing at your place you even need to be careful about.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Chicken tenders?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If they're up against Sasami, I'd be more worried for the dine-and-dasher. So, Auntie, what kind of dine-and-dasher are we talking about?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Well, you see, they just leave weird things behind and don't pay a cent~」

name: Synn
message: 「What kind of weird things?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Just weird things! Incomprehensible tools or things that look like toys. You can't even tell how to use them or play with them.」

name: Synn
message: 「That sure is troubling.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「And on top of that, they'll eat anything! They even gnawed on a whole thick daikon radish completely raw~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa. How wild.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd think they'd run off with it, so they eat it right on the spot?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Well, they aren't human, so maybe their customs are different.」

name: Synn
message: 「Not human?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way.」
We looked at each other.

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Yeah, yeah, guys like that... with shapes you can't make heads or tails of.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, where are they!?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Right over there.」

name: Synn
message: 「They appeared!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They're gnawing on pickled daikon!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, compared to gnawing on raw daikon, they might actually have a sense of taste.」

name: Girl
message: 「Hey! Don't eat it all by yourself! No sneaking ahead!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
I feel like I've met this kid somewhere before...

name: Mochimochi
message: 「Eee.」

name: Jangara
message: 「Eee!?」

name: Tinun
message: 「Eee!!」

name: Girl
message: 「Is it really that good? Let me see.」

name: Girl
message: 「It's delicious! It goes great with rice!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Eee♪」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Ooh. As an apostle of truth, I've gotta get a picture of this!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, this is no time to be taking pictures! You dine-and-dashers!」

name: Girl
message: 「Dine-and-dashers? What bad guys!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm talking about you!」

name: Synn
message: 「And what's more, that rice bowl you're holding is from the beef bowl shop!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A double dine-and-dash?! How shameless!」

name: Girl
message: 「Mgh, wait--by dine-and-dashers, do you mean us?!」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't even have to ask, yes!」

name: Girl
message: 「We aren't dine-and-dashers!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then what do you call yourselves, you dine-and-dasher!」

name: Sally
message: 「What is with that unfair name?! I have a proper, super cute name--it's 'Sally-chan'!!」

name: Sally
message: 「And as for my merry companions!」

name: Sally
message: 「Mochimochi!」

name: Sally
message: 「Jangara!」

name: Sally
message: 「Tinun!」

name: Sally
message: 「And all together, we're--」

name: Sally
message: 「'The Delicious Food Squad♪'」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「I see, I see. Well then, let's take a group photo to commemorate this.」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh? W-well, alright. Make sure you take a good one, okay?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Leave it to the Apostle of Truth. Say cheese.」

name: Sally
message: 「Did I come out cute?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「I am the Apostle of Truth, after all. Turned out great. Look.」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa. I really do look cute!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn! Why are you throwing up a peace sign too?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I just kind of... Listen, you guys. No matter how high-sense a name you've got, dining and dashing is still dining and dashing.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, it's definitely not high-sense.」

name: Sally
message: 「It wasn't dining and dashing! We properly bartered and left something behind!」

name: Sally
message: 「Always smiling and paying in goods is the Delicious Food Squad's motto.」

name: Synn
message: 「It has to be cash, not goods. We're not living in the age of bartering anymore.」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm asking what \{cash|\s12\s12\s12\s12} even is! You're just picking a fight like that so you can extort more out of us!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, defensive much.」

name: Sally
message: 「Anyway, we didn't do anything wrong. And yet everyone's looking at us like we're a huge nuisance! Now I'm mad!」

name: Mochimochi
message: 「Eeee!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hm? What's wrong?」

name: Mochimochi
message: 「Eee!」

name: Sally
message: 「Whaaat!? Don't tell me you guys are the 'Student Council' Mochimochi was talking about!?」

name: Synn
message: 「We are, yeah...」

name: Sally
message: 「So you're with the jerks who bullied Mochimochi and the others!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, are you talking about when we fought over the meat bun ruckus? We weren't bullying them...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, those dine-and-dashers. Your luck finally ran out.」

name: Sally
message: 「That's my line! Your luck finally ran out! Now the time has come to avenge my comrades!」

name: Sally
message: 「Come on! Fight me, Student Council! I can take you lot on all by myself with ease!」

name: Synn
message: 「What a sudden turn of events!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Transform! ...Right after--」

name: Paqy
message: 「H-Hey, what's the big idea!」
Paqy, hurled by Nanaka, landed a direct hit right on Shina-oba's face.

name: Shina-oba
message: 「W-What is this! Everything went pitch-black!」

name: Synn
message: 「Must be the black part of the panda.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Never mind that, transform!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh!」
